declarations.docstring: Relates a signed scalar multiple of an auxiliary value to a coefficient of a polynomial product.
An auxiliary assertion whose type was unavailable from the displayed formal output.
The coefficient at `α + e` of a monomial at `e` times `P` is the monomial scalar times the coefficient of `P` at `α`.
A symmetric polynomial has equal coefficients at an exponent vector of total degree `n` and at its associated partition exponent.
An auxiliary assertion whose type was unavailable from the displayed formal output.
The permutation-indexed auxiliary multivariable polynomial is symmetric.
Forms a partition of `n` from a natural-valued finitely supported vector whose entries sum to `n`.
A partition component is complex-linearly equivalent to an indexed family of copies of the corresponding partition subspace.
An isotypic component is linearly equivalent over the auxiliary scalar ring to an indexed family of copies of a partition subspace.
An auxiliary natural-valued finitely supported function associated with a permutation of `Fin n`.
The natural cast of an auxiliary multiplicity equals a specified coefficient of the permutation-indexed polynomial.
The natural cast of an auxiliary multiplicity equals the trace of the partition permutation endomorphism.
The complex-linear endomorphism of a partition-indexed space associated with a permutation of `Fin n`.
The partition permutation endomorphism maps each partition component into itself.
A complex submodule of a partition-indexed space, indexed by a second partition.
Each partition component is finite as a complex module.
Each partition component is free as a complex module.
The complex scalars, auxiliary scalar ring, and partition-indexed space form a scalar tower.
The family of partition components gives an internal direct sum.
The partition-indexed family of isotypic components gives an internal direct sum.
An auxiliary natural-valued finitely supported function on `Fin n`.
An auxiliary assertion whose type was unavailable from the displayed formal output.
The complex-linear endomorphism of a partition subspace associated with a permutation of `Fin n`.
The complex character value associated with a partition and a permutation of `Fin n`.
Two partitions are equal when all their associated character values agree.
The finite-dimensional complex representation of permutations of `Fin n` associated with a partition of `n`.
The character of the partition-indexed finite-dimensional representation equals its associated character value.
Two partition-indexed finite-dimensional representations are isomorphic exactly when their partitions are equal.
The finite-dimensional representation associated with a partition is simple.
The complex representation of permutations of `Fin n` on the subspace associated with a partition.
Distinct partitions have no linear equivalence between their associated subspaces over the auxiliary scalar ring.
Every simple submodule of a partition-indexed space is linearly equivalent to a subspace associated with some partition.
The natural-valued multiplicity associated with two partitions of `n`.
The multiplicity of a partition with itself is one.
The partition multiplicity vanishes when the displayed auxiliary relation holds.
The partition multiplicity vanishes when the displayed auxiliary relation fails in the specified direction.
The sum of paired character values at a permutation and its inverse is `n!` for equal partitions and zero otherwise.
Under the stated pointwise bound, the entries of the difference between the combined exponent and the permutation exponent sum to `n`.
A symmetric multivariable polynomial has the same coefficient after permuting the domain of an exponent vector.
The trace of a partition permutation endomorphism restricted to a component is the component multiplicity times its character value.
Given the displayed linear equivalence, the restricted trace equals the component multiplicity times the trace on the associated partition subspace.
The multivariable polynomial obtained from signed monomials indexed by permutations of `Fin n`.
The alternating permutation polynomial is the sum of sign-weighted monomials at the associated permutation exponent vectors.
The natural cast of an auxiliary multiplicity is the sum of partition multiplicities times their character values.
